resources.string: Guided world navigation lesson
Each round runs for five active minutes, then saves and evaluates the candidate on 24 test worlds. Paused time is excluded. You choose whether to apply it.
Choose a world-navigation lesson
Level %1$d
Reach and interact with a visible target.
Explore until you find hidden food, then eat when needy.
Find food and water while both needs are active.
Learn movement, rest, and sleep transitions as energy changes.
Visit four biome types and navigate a larger world.
Gather wood, berries, and herbs, then return home.
Meet an NPC, leave, and return for another interaction.
Plant, water, and harvest a crop.
Recover hunger, hydration, and energy together.
Generalize navigation across unrestricted worlds.
Gameplay relevance: basic autonomous routing toward a known destination.
Gameplay relevance: discovering a resource while exploring.
Gameplay relevance: routing between resource needs.
Gameplay relevance: choosing safe movement around energy limits.
Gameplay relevance: crossing different world biomes.
Gameplay relevance: resource gathering and returning home.
Gameplay relevance: navigating to social encounters.
Gameplay relevance: reaching farm locations and returning between tasks.
Gameplay relevance: choosing routes while several needs compete.
Gameplay relevance: broader autonomous navigation generalization.
This teaches autonomous world navigation. It does not learn obedience, care routines, boxing, or home behavior.
